en: A sepia-toned or black-and-white studio photograph featuring two women dressed in early 20th-century fashion, including wide-brimmed hats and long skirts. The women are standing behind a faux-balustrade in front of a painted backdrop that imitates an outdoor garden or terrace scene. The image is framed with an arch at the top, typical of portrait postcards from the late 19th to early 20th century. There is no visible handwritten or printed text except for potential studio marks or embossing, which are not clearly legible.
